text: {"memo": "Netflix, Inc. (NFLX) delivered strong double‑digit growth in FY2024, with revenue climbing to $39.00\u202fbillion from $33.72\u202fbillion in FY2023—a 15.7% increase. Operating income rose to $10.42\u202fbillion, lifting the operating margin to 26.7% from 20.6% a year earlier. Net income improved to $8.71\u202fbillion, yielding a net profit margin of 22.3% versus 16.0% in FY2023. Diluted EPS surged to $19.83 per share from $12.03, reflecting robust earnings expansion. Operating cash flow remained solid at $7.36\u202fbillion, slightly above the $7.27\u202fbillion generated in FY2023. The company\u2019s margin expansion and earnings growth underscore its pricing power and content investment effectiveness. However, the modest rise in operating cash flow suggests limited improvement in cash generation efficiency. Overall, NFLX shows healthy top\u2011line acceleration and margin improvement, supporting a balanced risk/reward profile. View: Hold."}
